name: std::mutex::mutex
intro:
1) Constructs the mutex. The mutex is in unlocked state after the constructor completes.

2) Copy constructor is deleted.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Because the default constructor is constexpr, static mutexes are initialized as part of static non-local initialization, before any dynamic non-local initialization begins. This makes it safe to lock a mutex in a constructor of any static object.
